en.baptism: The draft merges five entries. (1) In the year one thousand nine hundred, on the [twentieth, garbled] day of August, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the vicar Fr. [illegible] baptised a child named Petronela with all the rites of the Sacrament. (2) In the year one thousand nine hundred, on the twentieth day of August, in the same church, the vicar Fr. Bantruken baptised a child named Susanna with all the rites of the Sacrament. (3) On the twenty-first day of August, in the same church, the vicar Fr. Bantruken baptised a child named Frants with all the rites. (4) On the twenty-[second?] day of August, in the same church, the vicar Fr. Tomaszewicz baptised a child named Ilka with all the rites. (5) On the twenty-third day of August, in the same church, the vicar Fr. Bantruken baptised a child named Petronela with all the rites.
en.parents: (1) Daughter of Ignatii Stakanis and Petronela née Lukoshgas, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on the 17th of August 1900 in the town of Plungė, of the same parish. (2) Daughter of Petr Shmbutas and Petronela née Rutis, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on the 18th of August 1900 in the village of Olkstianai of the Plungė parish. (3) Son of Frants Balosis and Petronela née Stanonkus, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on the 21st of August 1900 in the town of Plungė, of the same parish. (4) Daughter of Anton Stefanovich and Emilia née Milosas, lawfully married peasants of Zhoranskii district, born on the 22nd of August 1900 in the town of Plungė, of the same parish. (5) Daughter of Mateush Lukoshgas and Petronela née Ostrovskii, lawfully married peasants of Bernatovo district, born on the 22nd of August 1900 in the town of Plungė, of the same parish. [A garbled tail follows: 'Ргоневе Lи 1921т. 28 годь. уего Икiюо.']
en.godparents: (1) The godparents were Leon Gandykas and Varvara Stikanisovna, a maiden. (2) Ignatii Rutis and Varvara Vaitkusovna, a maiden. (3) Anton Bertovskii and Martsisiana Statevichovna, a maiden. (4) Anton Vaitkus and Bronislava Mltasovna, a maiden. (5) Kazimir Barzdzgas and Petronela, wife of Adam Skuvskii. (3) 1900 metų rugpjūčio 21 dieną toje pačioje bažnyčioje kunigas vikaras Bantruken su visomis apeigomis pakrikštijo kūdikį, vardu Pranciškus. (4) 1900 metų rugpjūčio 22 dieną toje pačioje bažnyčioje kunigas vikaras Tomaszewicz su visomis apeigomis pakrikštijo kūdikį, vardu Ilka. (5) 1900 metų rugpjūčio 23 dieną toje pačioje bažnyčioje kunigas vikaras Bantruken su visomis apeigomis pakrikštijo kūdikį, vardu Petronėlė.

issues.en: Draft contains five baptisms in one cell; order kept. Day of baptism 1 and 4 and first priest garbled; names Ilka and Martsisiana, and many surnames uncertain; tail of parents text and godparents text is noise; draft says 'супругою' etc. only for the fifth.
issues.lt: Juodraštyje viename langelyje penki krikštai; tvarka išlaikyta. 1 ir 4 krikšto dienos bei pirmojo kunigo pavardė iškraipytos; vardai Ilka ir Marcisiana bei daug pavardžių neaiškūs; tėvų ir krikštatėvių teksto pabaiga yra triukšmas.
